plugin.name: surface-names
plugin._long: Name the parts of each output on a workspace change, and on a toggle. Replaces workspace-names: any number of labels per output per workspace, each centred in its own rectangle (fractions of the output), so a split panel shows a label in each part.

option.name: toggle
option._long: Show every output's labels and keep them, following workspace changes, until pressed again. Also an IPC method of the same name.

option.name: display_duration
option._long: How long the labels show on a workspace change (ms).

option.name: position
option._long: Where a label sits within ITS rectangle.

option.name: margin
option._long: Distance from the rectangle's edge for an edge position.

option.name: background_radius
option._long: Radius for the corners of the background.

option.name: show_unlabelled
option._long: A workspace with no label on an output shows "Workspace N" over the whole output, as workspace-names did.

option.name: labels
option._long: Keyed OUTPUT_workspace_N_K (N row-major from 1, K distinct per workspace), each `FX FY FW FH TEXT`: the rectangle as fractions of the output, then the text.
